location_zh: 耳甲艇上方，小腸穴上方 👉 Box 10。

indications_en: Low back pain, tinnitus/deafness, hormonal imbalance, fatigue, irregular menses, infertility, edema, hair loss.

location: 耳甲腔或耳甲艇相鄰區，常與胃、腸點配伍。
locationEn: In the Inferior Concha or adjacent Superior Concha region, commonly combined with Stomach and intestinal auricular points.
functionsEn: Strengthen the Spleen, transform dampness, augment qi, and support transformation and transportation.
evidence: 脾胃耳穴多用於消化功能與疲勞相關配伍；持續腸胃症狀需醫療評估。
cautions: 黑便、體重下降、持續腹痛或脫水需就醫。

region: 耳輪腳消失處 / Around Helix Crus
location: 耳甲腔近耳輪腳根部區域。

functionsEn: Harmonize the Stomach, descend rebellious qi, ease nausea, and support digestion.
evidence: 耳穴胃常用於噁心與消化症狀配伍；急性腹症需先排除。
cautions: 劇烈腹痛、嘔血、黑便或持續嘔吐需就醫。

location_en: Around the origin/disappearance of the helix crus (middle junction of conchae).
functions_zh: 和胃降逆、理氣止痛、消食導滯、通降胃氣。

indications_en: Gastric pain, distension, nausea, vomiting, hiccups, acid reflux, chronic gastritis, eating disorders.

region: 耳輪腳上方 / Superior to Helix Crus
location: 耳甲腔下外側區，胃區附近。
locationEn: In the inferolateral concha, near the Stomach area on auricular maps.
functionsEn: Regulate the intestines, promote bowel movement, and move qi stagnation.
evidence: 腸道耳穴常用於便秘或腹瀉配伍；慢性或警訊症狀需檢查。
cautions: 便血、嚴重腹痛、發燒或脫水需就醫。

functionsEn: Benefit the mouth and throat, regulate appetite, and harmonize the Stomach.
evidence: 口區常與胃、神門、飢點等配伍；口腔感染或潰瘍持續需牙醫/醫師評估。

functions: 調食慾，和胃，輔助體重管理。
functionsEn: Regulate appetite, harmonize the Stomach, and support weight-management programs as an adjunct.
evidence: 耳穴減重/食慾研究結果不一致；應作飲食、運動與醫療管理的輔助。

exam_pearl: **耳穴考點 · 飢點 (Hunger Point)**：位於耳屏外側面中點！減肥餐前按壓首選穴。

location_zh: 耳屏外側面中點。
location_en: On the external surface of the tragus, at the midpoint.
functions_zh: 抑制食慾、調節下丘腦攝食中樞、減重降脂。

locationEn: Near the posterosuperior lobule or antitragus region, commonly used for head-neck and sleep-related prescriptions.
functionsEn: Clear the head and eyes, calm the spirit, and ease headache.
evidence: 枕區常用於頭痛、睡眠與頸項配伍；突發劇烈頭痛需急診評估。
cautions: 突發最嚴重頭痛、視力改變、肢體無力或言語困難需立即就醫。

functions_zh: 鎮靜安神、熄風止痛、清腦明目、止嘔平喘。

evidence: 眼區可作眼疲勞輔助配穴；視力急變、眼痛或外傷需眼科評估。
cautions: 突發視力下降、劇烈眼痛或眼外傷不可自行處理。

location_zh: 對耳輪體下 2/3 與 1/3 交界處。
location_en: On the antihelix body, at the junction of the lower 2/3 and 1/3.
functions_zh: 壯腰補腎、活血止痛、通利腰膝。
functions_en: Strengthen lower back, invigorate Blood, alleviate pain, disinhibit lumbosacral region.
indications_zh: 腰痛、急性腰扭傷、腰肌勞損、腰椎間盤突出、坐骨神經痛。
indications_en: Low back pain, acute lumbar sprain, lumbar muscle strain, herniated disc, sciatica.

region: 上對耳輪腳中段 / Superior Antihelix Crus
location: 對耳輪上腳或三角窩下緣附近，對應下肢關節區。
locationEn: Near the Superior AntiHelix Crus or lower Triangle Fossa, corresponding to the lower-limb joint area.
functionsEn: Relax sinews, activate collaterals, and relieve knee pain.
evidence: 膝區耳穴多用於疼痛配伍；急性腫脹外傷需排除骨折/韌帶損傷。
cautions: 膝部紅腫熱痛、不能負重或外傷後變形需就醫。

acumethod_zh: 皮下斜刺1-2分或耳豆貼壓。
acumethod_en: Subcutaneous oblique insertion 0.1-0.2 cun or ear seed press.
exam_pearl: **耳穴考點 · 膝 (Knee Joint)**：位於上對耳輪腳中段。屬於中胚層 (Mesoderm)。
exam_pearl_en: High-Yield Board Pearl: Located on superior antihelix crus midpoint. Mesoderm layer for knee joint pain.

location_zh: 上對耳輪腳中段。
location_en: At the midpoint of the superior antihelix crus.
functions_zh: 舒筋止痛、通利關節、祛風濕。
functions_en: Relax tendons, relieve joint pain, disinhibit knee joint, expel wind-damp.
indications_zh: 膝關節痛、膝關節炎、韌帶拉傷、下肢關節活動受限。
indications_en: Knee pain, osteoarthritis of knee, ligament strain, limited knee mobility.

location: 耳舟上部或耳輪與對耳輪之間凹陷區。
locationEn: In the upper Scaphoid Fossa, the groove between the Helix and AntiHelix.
functionsEn: Relax the shoulder, open the collaterals, and relieve pain.
evidence: 肩區耳穴常與神門、交感配伍作疼痛輔助。
cautions: 肩痛伴胸痛、呼吸困難或外傷後無力需就醫。

acumethod_zh: 皮下斜刺1-2分或耳豆貼壓。
acumethod_en: Subcutaneous oblique insertion 0.1-0.2 cun or ear seed press.
exam_pearl: **耳穴考點 · 肩 (Shoulder)**：位於舟窩 (Scaphoid Fossa)。屬於中胚層 (Mesoderm)。
exam_pearl_en: High-Yield Board Pearl: Located in Scaphoid Fossa. Mesoderm layer for frozen shoulder & shoulder pain.

國際標準耳針 3D / 區域定位對照 · 肩

location_zh: 舟窩中段（指與肘穴下方）。
location_en: In the middle segment of the scaphoid fossa (below Finger and Elbow points).
functions_zh: 通絡止痛、舒筋活血、利肩關節。
functions_en: Unblock collaterals, relieve pain, relax tendons, disinhibit shoulder joint.
indications_zh: 肩周炎（五十肩）、肩部肌肉酸痛、肩關節拉傷、肩胛痛。
indications_en: Frozen shoulder (periarthritis of shoulder), shoulder stiffness & pain, rotator cuff strain.

region: 三角窩凹陷處 / Triangular Fossa (Uterus/Pelvis)
location: 三角窩內下部，靠近對耳輪下腳區。
locationEn: In the lower Triangle Fossa, near the Inferior AntiHelix Crus region.
functionsEn: Regulate menstruation, relieve menstrual pain, and regulate the lower burner.
evidence: 婦科耳穴需依正式診斷輔助使用；不明出血或妊娠相關症狀不可自行處理。
cautions: 孕期、不明陰道出血、劇烈腹痛或疑似感染需就醫。

國際標準耳針 3D / 區域定位對照 · 子宮

acumethod_zh: 直刺1分或耳豆貼壓。子宮/盆腔與神門同在三角窩，神門位置高於盆腔。
acumethod_en: Perpendicular insertion 0.1 cun or ear seed press. Located in Triangular Fossa with Shenmen.
exam_pearl: **耳穴考點 · 子宮 / 盆腔 (Uterus / Pelvic Cavity)**：位於三角窩 (Triangular Fossa)。神門 (Shenmen) 位置高於盆腔。
exam_pearl_en: High-Yield Board Pearl: Located in Triangular Fossa. Shenmen is superior to Pelvic Cavity.

國際標準耳針 3D / 區域定位對照 · 子宮

location_zh: 三角窩前上方凹陷處（耳輪內緣旁）。
location_en: In the triangular fossa, at the antero-superior aspect adjacent to the inner helix margin.
functions_zh: 調經止痛、補腎益精、收斂止血、調理衝任。
functions_en: Regulate menses, relieve menstrual pain, tonify Kidney, harmonize Chong & Ren vessels.
indications_zh: 痛經 (Dysmenorrhea)、月經不調、子宮下垂、功能性子宮出血、不孕症、產後復舊。
indications_en: Dysmenorrhea, irregular menses, uterine prolapse, dysfunctional uterine bleeding, infertility.

location: 耳輪腳上，常用於膈肌與胃氣上逆相關配伍。
locationEn: On the Crus of Helix, commonly used in auricular maps for diaphragm-related and rebellious Stomach qi patterns.
functionsEn: Open the chest, direct rebellious qi downward, harmonize the Stomach, and relieve hiccup in traditional use.
evidence: 常見耳針教材列為膈區相關點；需與完整病因辨識配合。
cautions: 持續嘔吐、胸痛、吞嚥困難或黑便需就醫。

acumethod_zh: 直刺1分或耳豆貼壓。膈穴為血會膈俞之耳穴延伸，主治打嗝與血瘀。
acumethod_en: Perpendicular insertion 0.1 cun or ear seed press. Essential point for intractable hiccups & blood stasis.
exam_pearl: **耳穴考點 · 膈 (Diaphragm)**：位於耳輪腳上。臨床治療頑固性打嗝 (Hiccups) 與血瘀皮膚病首選。
exam_pearl_en: High-Yield Board Pearl: Located on helix crus. Primary point for intractable hiccups & blood stasis.

國際標準耳針 3D / 區域定位對照 · 膈

location_zh: 耳輪腳上（零點附近）。
location_en: On the helix crus (near Point Zero).
functions_zh: 寬胸理氣、和胃降逆、活血祛瘀、止打嗝。
functions_en: Relax chest, harmonize Stomach, lower rebellious Qi, invigorate Blood, relieve hiccups.
indications_zh: 頑固性打嗝（呃逆）、胃氣上逆、食道痙攣、皮膚病（血瘀型）、胸悶。
indications_en: Intractable hiccups, acid reflux, esophageal spasm, blood-stasis skin diseases, chest tightness.

region: 耳甲艇前上部 / Anterior Cymba Conchae
location: 耳甲艇內，靠近對耳輪下腳下緣與大腸直上方區。
locationEn: In the Superior Concha, near the inferior border of the Inferior AntiHelix Crus and superior to the Large Intestine region.
functionsEn: Promote urination, benefit strangury patterns, and regulate Bladder qi transformation.
evidence: A+醫學百科耳針表將膀胱列於耳甲艇部；定位需與圖譜版本核對。
cautions: 血尿、發燒腰痛、尿閉或疑似腎盂腎炎需立即就醫。

acumethod_zh: 直刺1分或耳豆貼壓。
acumethod_en: Perpendicular insertion 0.1 cun or ear seed press.
exam_pearl: **耳穴考點 · 膀胱 (Bladder)**：屬於內胚層 (Endoderm)，位於耳甲艇。主治尿路感染與小便不利。
exam_pearl_en: High-Yield Board Pearl: Endoderm organ in cymba concha for cystitis & urinary tract disorders.

國際標準耳針 3D / 區域定位對照 · 膀胱

location_zh: 耳甲艇前上方（腎穴前下方）。
location_en: In the cymba conchae, antero-superior aspect (anterior-inferior to Kidney point).
functions_zh: 清熱利濕、通利小便、通絡止痛。
functions_en: Clear heat, promote urination, unblock urinary tract, relieve pain.
indications_zh: 膀胱炎、尿路感染、小便不利、尿頻尿急、遺尿、下背痛。
indications_en: Cystitis, urinary tract infection, dysuria, urinary frequency/urgency, enuresis, low back pain.

location: 耳甲腔內，口與心穴之間。
locationEn: In the Inferior Concha, between the Mouth and Heart auricular regions.
functionsEn: Diffuse the Lung, benefit the throat, relieve cough, and calm wheezing in traditional use.
evidence: 常見耳針教材列於耳甲腔部呼吸相關區。
cautions: 呼吸困難、喘鳴急性加重、唇紫或高熱需立即就醫。

acumethod_zh: 直刺1分或耳豆貼壓。心穴部位選 **Central deepest depression, posterior to Trachea**。
acumethod_en: Perpendicular insertion 0.1 cun or ear seed. Heart point is located posterior to Trachea point.
exam_pearl: **耳穴考點 · 氣管 (Trachea)**：位於外耳道口與心穴之間。心穴位於氣管穴後方。
exam_pearl_en: High-Yield Board Pearl: Located between external auditory meatus and Heart point.

location_zh: 外耳道口與心穴之間。
location_en: Between the external auditory meatus orifice and the Heart point.
functions_zh: 宣肺平喘、化痰止咳、利咽通氣。
functions_en: Disperse Lung Qi, relieve asthma, transform phlegm, stop cough, disinhibit throat.
indications_zh: 急性與慢性支氣管炎、哮喘、咳嗽、氣喘胸悶。
indications_en: Acute & chronic bronchitis, asthma, cough, wheezing, chest discomfort.

location: 耳屏內側面，與外耳道口相對處。
locationEn: On the medial surface of the Tragus, opposite the external acoustic meatus.
functionsEn: Clear and benefit the throat, reduce swelling, and relieve pain in traditional use.
evidence: A+醫學百科耳針表列咽喉於耳屏部。
cautions: 吞嚥困難、呼吸困難、單側頸部腫脹或高熱需就醫。

acumethod_zh: 皮下淺刺1分或耳豆貼壓。耳屏處常見鼻喉呼吸道穴位（Tragus = Airway entrance）。
acumethod_en: Superficial insertion 0.1 cun or ear seed. Tragus = Airway entrance.
exam_pearl: **耳穴考點 · 咽喉 (Pharynx-Larynx)**：位於耳屏內側。Tragus (耳屏) 為呼吸道入口，集中耳鼻喉穴位。
exam_pearl_en: High-Yield Board Pearl: Located on inner tragus wall. Tragus represents airway entrance.

location_zh: 耳屏內側面槽內上1/2處。
location_en: On the inner surface of the tragus, upper half.
functions_zh: 清熱解毒、利咽消腫、宣肺開音。
functions_en: Clear heat and detoxify, benefit throat, reduce swelling, restore voice.
indications_zh: 咽喉腫痛、急性扁桃體炎、失音（聲音嘶啞）、感冒咽痛。
indications_en: Sore throat, acute tonsillitis, hoarseness/aphonia, pharyngitis.

region: 耳屏外側面正中 / Center of Outer Tragus
location: 耳屏外側中央附近。
locationEn: Near the center of the lateral surface of the Tragus.
functionsEn: Open the nasal orifices, dispel wind, and clear heat in traditional use.
evidence: A+醫學百科耳針表列外鼻於耳屏部。
cautions: 單側鼻出血不止、面部劇痛、發燒或疑似感染需就醫。

acumethod_zh: 淺刺1分或耳豆貼壓（Tragus = Airway entrance）。
acumethod_en: Superficial insertion 0.1 cun or ear seed press.
exam_pearl: **耳穴考點 · 外鼻 (External Nose)**：位於耳屏外側面正中點 (Tragus)。主治鼻塞與過敏性鼻炎。
exam_pearl_en: High-Yield Board Pearl: Located at tragus external midpoint. Primary point for nasal congestion & rhinitis.

location_zh: 耳屏外側面正中點。
location_en: At the exact midpoint of the external surface of the tragus.
functions_zh: 宣肺通鼻、清熱祛風、解表通竅。
functions_en: Disperse Lung Qi, unblock nose, clear heat, expel wind.
indications_zh: 鼻塞、過敏性鼻炎、鼻竇炎、酒糟鼻（酒渣鼻）、外鼻發炎。
indications_en: Nasal congestion, allergic rhinitis, sinusitis, rosacea, external nasal inflammation.

region: 耳廓背面溝 / Groove of Posterior Auricle
location: 耳廓背面，由內上方斜向外下方行走的凹溝處。
locationEn: On the Posterior Surface of the auricle, along the groove running obliquely from the superomedial to inferolateral region.
functions: 平肝潛陽，輔助調節血壓。
functionsEn: Pacify the Liver, anchor yang, and support blood-pressure regulation as an adjunctive traditional auricular point.
evidence: A+醫學百科耳針表列降壓溝於耳廓背面；血壓管理需以醫療診斷與監測為主。
cautions: 血壓危象、胸痛、神經學症狀或用藥調整需由醫師處理。

acumethod_zh: 降壓溝點刺放血 3-5 滴（配合耳尖放血效果更佳）；或由上往下刮痧貼壓。降壓溝點刺放血為耳穴降壓最速効法！
acumethod_en: Bloodletting 3-5 drops with prism needle (commonly paired with Ear Apex bloodletting) for rapid BP reduction.
exam_pearl: **耳穴降壓第一考點 · 降壓溝 (Hypertension Groove)**：耳背溝點刺放血（配合耳尖放血）為耳針降高血壓最快最速傚手法！
exam_pearl_en: High-Yield Board Pearl: Primary bloodletting site on ear back (paired with Ear Apex) for rapid blood pressure lowering.

location_zh: 耳廓背面，對耳輪上下腳及其主幹凹溝處（耳背溝）。
location_en: On the back of the ear, in the depression corresponding to the antihelix crura and body.
functions_zh: 平肝降壓、清熱瀉火、鎮靜安神、活血疏風。
functions_en: Pacify Liver, lower blood pressure, clear heat, calm Shen, invigorate Blood.
indications_zh: 高血壓 (Hypertension)、頭暈目眩、頭痛、皮膚搔癢。
indications_en: Hypertension, severe dizziness, headache, pruritus.
